The TenCommandments of Crate Day

Commandment 1Thou shall begin at midday

Commandment 2Thou shall listen to The Rock Crate Day Hundy

Commandment 3Thou shall wear thy stubbies and thy singlet

Commandment 4Thou shall support thy crate of origin

Commandment 5Thou shall not toss any salad

Commandment 6Thou shall respect thy neighbour

Commandment 7Thou only beef that shall attend National Crate Day is thy beef for thy BBQ

Commandment 8Thou shall look out for thy mates, even Dave

Commandment 9Don't let the sun get thy best of thou and thoust provisions

Commandment 10Thou shall always keep rules 1–9 top of mind to ensure we continue the National Crate Day legacy for centuries to come
